subject: MAP: Nimbus Health pilot & compliance add-on pricing
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Whitfield <sara.whitfield@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Tom Baker <tom.baker@nimbushealth.com>
Date: 2026-02-10T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: MAP draft and pilot timeline for Nimbus Health

Hi Sara,

Thanks again for the time on Friday — attaching a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and an initial pricing workbook that isolates compliance add-ons (audit logs, retention tiers, premium controls). High-level proposal:

- Pilot (4 weeks): evaluation with a seeded dataset, performance & safety checks, basic observability.
- Evaluation (4 weeks): embed tests, prompt cal, quality sign-off using your checklist.
- Ramp & Commit (8 weeks): production rollout with capacity ramps and monitoring.

Key commercial notes in the attachment: discounts scale with committed GPU-months (ramp milestones in the MAP). Compliance SKUs are priced separately; I call these out so the MAP milestones can trigger rebates/discounts on the compliance seat pricing.

Questions for you:
1) Would Nimbus prefer a 3-month pilot then a 12-month commit, or an accelerated 8-week pilot into an 18-month commitment? Discounts differ by commit term in the workbook.
2) For audit logs retention, are you looking for short-term (30/90 days), 1-year retention, or long-term (7+ years) archival? That changes the pricing materially.

Attachments: Nimbus_MAP_v1.pdf, Pricing_Compliance_SKUs.xlsx

If the MAP looks ok I can update with explicit milestone-based discounts (e.g., 10% ramp rebate once 40% of committed capacity is reached; 15% on 12-mo; 20% on 24-mo).

Best,
Monica
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: MAP draft and pilot timeline for Nimbus Health

Monica — thank you, this is helpful. A couple clarifying items before we loop procurement: 

- Can you break out audit logs pricing? We need: baseline (30/90d), 1-year retention (hot storage), and 7-year archival. Please show both $/GB/mo and a fixed SKU for enterprise archival.
- How exactly do the MAP milestones map to discounts? We prefer milestones tied to committed throughput (GPU-hours) rather than calendar dates.
- Any evidence for cost of retention (e.g., incremental storage and retrieval costs) so procurement can model TCO?

Procurement is on copy — Tom/Procurement, we plan to do an initial 4-week pilot. We will need SOC2 evidence and the standard security addendum.

Thanks,
Sara
Director of Clinical AI | Nimbus Health

Date: 2026-02-11T10:42:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft and pilot timeline for Nimbus Health

Hi Sara / Tom — great questions. I updated the pricing workbook and attached a short appendix below with the compliance SKUs. See attached Pricing_Compliance_SKUs.xlsx. Summary: 

Compliance SKU summary (excerpt):
- Audit Logs - Basic (30/90d) : included at no additional charge with hosted API; retention 30 days default; searchable in Console.
- Audit Logs - Premium (1 year hot retention) : $0.85 / GB / month (hot), includes enhanced UI, export hooks, and audit exports.
- Audit Logs - Archival (7 years) : one-time archival indexing fee + $0.12 / GB / month cold storage. Archival SKU also includes notarized integrity logs (for regulated audit).
- Premium Controls (role-based masking, KMS-integrated key rotation): $2,500 / month per customer for enterprise tenants (or invoiced as a line item on Private deployments).

MAP discounts tied to committed GPU-hours (proposal):
- Commit Tier 1 (>= 250 GPU-hours/month avg over first 3 months): 10% platform discount + 5% off compliance SKUs
- Commit Tier 2 (>= 750 GPU-hours/month avg over first 3 months): 15% platform discount + 10% off compliance SKUs
- Commit Tier 3 (>= 1,500 GPU-hours/month avg): 20% platform discount + 15% off compliance SKUs

We can map ramp milestones to these tiers — e.g., MAP milestone A (pilot complete + production smoke): floor for Tier 1; milestone B (50% of target throughput sustained for 14 days): eligible for Tier 2, etc. Rafael is looped here to confirm discount authority; Vivek can chime on retention cost assumptions for long-term archival.

Attachments: Pricing_Compliance_SKUs.xlsx (updated)

Best,
Monica

----
(Attachment stub: Pricing_Compliance_SKUs.xlsx)

Monica — thanks, that level of detail helps. A few notes from procurement: 

- Nimbus would accept the MAP if Redwood can commit to SOC2 Type II evidence and a 99.9% SLA for Dedicated once we go live. Please provide the evidence link.
- On pricing, our preference is to include Premium Audit Logs as a deal-level add-on. We would expect at least a 20% discount on the premium audit logs SKU if we sign a 24-month Dedicated commit. If Redwood prefers shorter terms, we can consider an 18-month commit with a 12-15% discount.

Procurement — please advise if these are deal stoppers. We're trying to keep the MAP timeline tight: pilot week of 2/23, evaluation through mid-March, contract signature end of March.

Thanks,
Sara

Subject: Internal - discount approval & compliance SKU pricing for Nimbus Health

Team — quick ask: Nimbus is pushing for a 20% discount on Premium Audit Logs for a 24-month Dedicated commit. They are open to 18 months at 12-15%. Proposed counter: offer 15% off Premium Audit Logs for an 18-month committed term + 10% ramp rebate (applied to month following milestone B). Platform discounts follow the GPU-hour tiers shared earlier.

Rationale: audit logs premium is mostly storage + indexing + UI work. Vivek — can you confirm the marginal cost for 1-year hot retention vs 7-year archival so we can justify our counter? Rafael / Laura — do we have precedent authorizations for 15% on compliance SKUs on mid-market deals, or do I need an escalated pricing exception?

If we sign, I will document the milestone-based rebate inside the MAP and prepare a DocuSign with the compliance add-on as a separate line item.

Thanks,
Monica

----

Sara / Tom — thanks for the clarity and for looping procurement. We reviewed internally and can do the following final commercial position if Nimbus is willing to sign by end of March and commit to an 18-month Dedicated term (deal ID: NIM-2026-042):

- Premium Audit Logs: 15% off (applies to the $0.85/GB/mo hot retention price) for an 18-month Dedicated commit.
- Ramp rebate: 10% credit on platform invoice applied the month after hitting MAP Milestone B (sustained 50% of target GPU-hours for 14 days).
- Archival (7-year): unchanged base cold storage price ($0.12/GB/mo) but we will waive the one-time archival indexing fee for this deal.
- SOC2 Type II report: attached (SOC2_Report_Redwood_2025.pdf). Dedicated SLA: we will include a 99.9% uptime commitment in the SOW.

I have attached an updated MAP that enumerates the MAP milestones and ties the ramp rebate and discount triggers to measurable throughput milestones. If that is acceptable I will generate a DocuSign with the compliance add-on line item and the SOW annex.
